## ✨ Added
- **READY log banner** - the container prints a loud `MATRIX IS READY` banner to the log once Synapse answers on its health endpoint (`127.0.0.1:8008/health`), so you can tell when the 30 to 60 s first start has finished.
- **Docker Hub image** - the image is now mirrored to Docker Hub (`junkerderprovinz/matrix`) alongside GHCR (which stays the primary registry), giving a shorter pull tag.
- **Boot smoke-test gate.** CI boots Synapse against a throwaway PostgreSQL and waits for `/health` before publishing `:latest`.

## 🎨 Design
- New shared init-log banner.

## ⚡ Improved
- The Unraid template and README now reference the Docker Hub image.
- The template `Project` link points at the official Matrix site; the GitHub repo stays reachable via the ReadMe link and the Overview.
- The Unraid template now lives in the central templates feed.
- **Upgrade cleanup.** On start the container strips any stale `include_config_files` block from an existing `homeserver.yaml`, so the file matches what Synapse really reads.
- **Orphaned-SQLite warning.** If a legacy `/data/homeserver.db` is found, the container now warns that Synapse will use PostgreSQL from now on and points you at `synapse_port_db` in case you need to migrate the old SQLite data first.

## 🐛 Fixed
- **First-boot config generation is now guarded.** If generation failed, the old code wrote a stub `homeserver.yaml` and then skipped generation on every later boot, a permanent crash loop until you deleted the stub by hand. A generation failure now halts the container with a clear error instead.
- **Admin bootstrap no longer destroys its own credentials on a transient error.** Any non-"already exists" failure (connection refused, wrong registration shared secret) was treated as success: the admin user was silently never created and never retried. It now only marks itself done on real success or an actual "user exists", and otherwise retries on the next start.
- **TURN relay actually works.** The coturn relay UDP port range is now pinned and exposed (and surfaced in the Unraid template), so relayed voice/video calls flow instead of allocating internally and silently failing.
- **Secret-bearing rendered config** (`homeserver-overrides.yaml`, which holds the Postgres password and TURN secret) is now written `chmod 600`.
- **READY banner** no longer prints on a readiness timeout.
- **Synapse no longer silently falls back to SQLite.** A regression after v2.0.1 dropped the second `--config-path` that loads `homeserver-overrides.yaml` and brought back the inert `include_config_files` directive in `homeserver.yaml`. Synapse does not honor `include_config_files`, so the overrides (PostgreSQL, federation, TURN, registration) were dead config again and the server ran on SQLite at `/data/homeserver.db`. The overrides are now passed to Synapse via a second `--config-path` once more, so your configured database, federation, and TURN settings actually take effect. Thanks to the reporter in issue #3 for catching that the v2.0.1 fix had not actually landed on `main`.
